serviceProcess:
Our technician first inspects your AC in front of you and clearly explains if anything is wrong.

No part is ever changed without your permission. If a part needs replacing, we tell you its price and warranty before starting the work — parts are billed at market price only, with no hidden markup.

During the service, we thoroughly check for gas leakage and the condition of the compressor and motor.

This is followed by a deep clean — soft foam and jet washing of the indoor and outdoor units, along with cleaning the surrounding area. This improves cooling and reduces your electricity bill.

At the end, we show you the AC working properly in front of you. Payment is taken only after you are fully satisfied.
aboutText: Regular AC service keeps cooling stronger and power bills lower — dust on the filter and coil, and a slowly dropping gas level, both quietly reduce performance over time. Our Foam Jet Service deep-cleans the indoor and outdoor units with a foam wash plus high-pressure jet, clearing grime a dry wipe can't reach. We handle AC service, Foam Jet Service, gas refill, installation, and repair — split or window.

serviceProcess:
Our technician checks your washing machine in front of you first and clearly explains any problem found — nothing is hidden.

No part is replaced without your permission. If a part needs replacing, we tell you its price and warranty first — parts are billed at market price only, with no hidden markup.

We check the motor, drum, drain pump, water inlet valve, and the belt/pulley (top load) or door seal (front load) for wear and proper working.

Deep service includes cleaning the drum and detergent tray, removing lint and scale buildup, cleaning the filter, and checking for smooth, balanced spinning — this keeps your clothes cleaner and the machine running longer.

At the end, we run a test wash in front of you to show smooth washing, spinning and draining. Payment is taken only once you are satisfied.
aboutText: Semi-automatic, front-load, or top-load — regular servicing keeps your washing machine running smoothly and catches worn parts before they turn into bigger repairs. Drum cleaning, drain checks, and a proper inspection go a long way. We handle installation, repair, and routine maintenance right at your doorstep.

serviceProcess:
Our technician checks your RO/water purifier in front of you — testing the TDS level, filters and membrane — and clearly explains what's working and what needs attention.

No filter or part is changed without your permission. If a replacement is needed, we tell you its price and warranty first — parts are billed at market price only, with no hidden markup.

We check the pre-filters (sediment and carbon), the RO membrane, the UV lamp (if fitted), pump pressure, and all pipes and joints for leakage.

Deep service includes sanitising the storage tank and cleaning or replacing filters as needed, so the water stays safe and tastes fresh.

At the end, we show you the TDS reading and water flow in front of you. Payment is taken only after you're satisfied with the water quality.
aboutText: RO purifiers need regular filter changes and membrane checks to keep giving you clean, safe drinking water — skip it too long and both water quality and flow start to drop. We handle RO installation, filter replacement, and repair, and give honest advice on when a part genuinely needs replacing.

serviceProcess:
Our technician checks your fridge in front of you — cooling, compressor sound, gas level, thermostat and door seal — and clearly explains any issue found.

No part is changed without your permission. If a part needs replacing, we tell you its price and warranty first — parts are billed at market price only, with no hidden markup.

We check for gas leakage, compressor condition, thermostat/temperature control, and dust buildup on the condenser coils.

Deep service includes cleaning the condenser coils and drain, cleaning the interior, and checking the door seal — a proper seal keeps cooling steady and lowers your electricity bill.

At the end, we check the cooling in front of you. Payment is taken only once you're fully satisfied.
aboutText: Your refrigerator runs every hour of every day, so small issues — a loose door seal, an overworked compressor, uneven cooling — build up quietly and push your electricity bill up before anything visibly breaks. Single door, double door, or deep fridge each has its own maintenance needs. Our technicians spot these early signs and replace only the part that's actually damaged.
